PETREX GMBH, located at Wachtendonker Straße 11, D-47906 Kempen, Germany, is a dynamic chemical company committed to delivering high-quality chemical solutions for industrial and specialty applications. Combining technical expertise with a customer-focused approach, PETREX GMBH serves a broad range of sectors including manufacturing, coatings, polymers, lubricants, and specialty formulation houses. The company’s operations are driven by a focus on innovation, process reliability, and regulatory compliance, ensuring that products meet stringent safety, performance and environmental standards required by today’s markets.

At the core of PETREX GMBH is a team of experienced chemists, engineers and technical specialists who collaborate closely with clients to develop tailored formulations and problem-solving services. Whether providing off-the-shelf materials or bespoke chemical blends, PETREX emphasizes consistency, traceability and scalable production capabilities to support small-batch prototypes as well as larger commercial volumes. Production practices are designed to optimize efficiency while minimizing environmental impact, aligning with modern sustainability goals and sound waste-management principles.

Customer service and technical support play a central role in PETREX’s philosophy. The company prioritizes transparent communication, timely delivery and thorough documentation — from safety data sheets to technical datasheets and application guidance. PETREX also invests in continuous improvement, staying abreast of advances in raw materials, process technology and regulatory changes to maintain competitive advantage and help customers meet evolving product requirements.

With its strategic location in Kempen, Germany, PETREX GMBH is well positioned to serve both national and international clients, offering reliable logistics and responsive supply-chain management. For organizations seeking a trusted chemical partner that combines professional expertise with practical, client-oriented solutions, PETREX GMBH represents a capable and adaptable choice.
